description: Node badge bootstrap and API-node pricing: installing badge derivation as the legacy canvas row source, redrawing when badge settings or pricing change, evaluating per-node API pricing from node definitions and widget values, and parity between legacy canvas and Vue node badge rendering. The badge system under src/systems, badge drawing in LiteGraph, and Vue badge partitioning stay with their owners.

characterizationScenarios.name: Badge bootstrap installs once and redraws on settings and pricing changes
API node pricing evaluates price badges from widget values
Legacy canvas and Vue node badges render the same rows

compatibilityPromises: Inventory preserves existing exports and runtime behavior without granting public entry points or cross-module dependency permissions.
